execution_hints: Use one deterministic local script when helpful; place it in the current workspace root, never an operating-system temporary directory.
Do not install dependencies or use network access; use the standard library and only packages that already import successfully.
Write text artifacts explicitly as UTF-8 and keep generated source ASCII-safe on Windows by using Unicode escape sequences when needed.
method_contract: Run directed least-cost search from every facility using time_minutes and use facility_id as the deterministic tie-break for equal costs.
A demand is covered only when its least travel time is less than or equal to the fixture cutoff; retain reachable-but-uncovered and unreachable demands.
Count each demand population once in population totals even when more than one facility is within the cutoff.

requirements: Use this exact column order and write one row for every demand point.
Serialize node paths as greater-than-separated node IDs with no spaces, for example NODE1>NODE2; use the same representation in every artifact.
Use pipe-separated, facility_id-sorted IDs when multiple facilities are within cutoff.
For unreachable demands write lowercase false and empty CSV cells for assigned_facility, travel_time_minutes, facilities_within_cutoff, and path; never write literal null, None, or a JSON array.
Use a FeatureCollection in the fixture CRS.
Include one point feature for every uncovered demand.
Use JSON null for unavailable assigned facility and travel time properties.
Calculate population totals from unique demand IDs.
Report coverage_share as covered_population divided by total_population.
